gloss: to create; to originate; to bring into being

definitions.gloss: to create; to originate; to found
definitions.explanation: To bring into existence something that did not exist before — a work of art, a company, a culture, a new future. A kanji variant of {作|つく}る chosen when the writer wants to stress originality rather than manufacture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}る。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}った。

だれか⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{創|つく}りたい。
examples.english: Rather than walking a path someone else decided, I want to create my own future myself.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. There is no separate intransitive partner — use ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ or ⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ for the resulting state.

WRITING:
つくる has three common kanji, all read the same and all conjugating identically:
- ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: the default, for making things of any size
- ⟦{造|つく}る→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧: for building or brewing large or physical things — ships, houses, sake
- {創|つく}る: for originating something new — a work, a company, an era
{創|つく}る is outside the standard ⟦{常用漢字|じょうようかんじ}→常用漢字：20778_jouyoukanji⟧ readings, so official documents and textbooks normally write ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ instead. It is common in slogans, mission statements, and company names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}る: to create the future
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}る: to create a culture
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}る: to found a company
- ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創|つく}る: to create value
